alterations.description: From the visuals of girls in the background of the credits, all shots of girls in bikinis in which their bare busts and thighs are prominently visible.
From dialogue of Easy addressed to Abigail the words 'You better kiss him when he is concious and then find out what he does.'
Shots of Easy and Abigail in their revealing rain-soaked dresses, along with Roger's dialogue 'You are beginning to look as though you have no clothes.'
Shots of Abigail's bare thighs as she jumps off the bed to check up the time, while she is lying on her stomach in bed and while talking on phone.
Shot of Abigail's bare thighs while sitting crosslegged on the arm of a chair.
The remark of Cadwalader referring to Roger: 'You are lucky in selling your wild oats before you got married and not after.'
The underlined words from the dialogue of the Red Indian addressed to Roger when he finds Abigail inside the latter's hut: 'What me to pick you up like tomorrow morning- happy hunting.'
To the minimum shots of Tex in a transparent negligee revealing her scantily-clad figure.
To a flush the scene in which Easy finds the zipper of her frock getting stuck deleting shots in which her bare waist and panties are prominently seen.
Close-ups of all kisses between Tom and Sophie and Tom and Molly.
The first shot of Tom kissing Lady Bellaston.
Shot of Square standing almost naked near Molly's bed.
Shot of Square Western falling on hay with a girl.
Shot of Molly with partly bare bust, her kissing and embracing Tom, their falling together in the ditch and throwing up their garments.
All shots of Tom rushing from Mrs. Waters bed and running about without his trousers.
Near-views of Mrs. Waters with her bare bosom prominently visible while walking behind Tom.
Shot of Molly and Tom falling down suggestively in the bushes.
Shots of Molly And Tom lying together kissing and embracing each other, retaining only Molly's dialogue asking Tom to get her a post with Mrs. Western.
From the dialogue of Western at dinner table, the words from his remark: 'What a little whore master that boy is!'

Shot of Squire Western lifting up the skirt of a girl and falling down with her suggestively before the start of the hunt along with the dialogue of one of the men: 'It is too early, you will tire yourself.'

Narration about Tom and Molly: 'Tom always thought that any woman was better than none, while Molly never felt that one man was quite as good as two.' Shot of Tom lying on the ground holding Molly's skirt and pulling her down over him. Also shot of Tom and Molly rolling down the slope.
Shot of Squire Western slapping a girl's behind and falling with her on hay.
Shot of Western lying with and rolling over a girl on hay.
Near-views of Mrs. Waters bare back and exposed bust as she walks behind Tom.
Shots of Tom and Mrs. Waters together in bed.
All shots of Tom running up and down without his trousers and putting those on while Mrs. Waters is in bed, retaining the shot when he finds Sophie's muff.
Shot of Fitzpatrick starting to get undressed while looking at Mrs. Waters in bed and putting out the light.
Entirely the scene between Tom and Lady Bellaston lying together in bed.
To the minimum the erotic mouth play with food between Tom and Mrs. Waters, deleting all shots after Mrs. Waters eats her oyster.
Shots showing class boys beating Ramu and snatching crutches.
Delete the shots of Kumari Jayanti inadequately clad appearing in the beauty contest.
Reduce the police unsuccessfully chasing Miss Lucy.
In the dance song, delete Gandhi lifting Devi, and all near kissing shots of Devi and Gandhi.
In the dance song, delete the close-up inter-cut shots of ill clad Anglo Indian dancer.
Delete all references to Thair and Thairkarl, wherever it occurs. (Replacement with words Paal and Paalkarl approved).
Song 7 – Delete the words Nadikanad and Munretra Padhayadi occurring in lines 2 and 11. (Replacement with words Azhakanadi and Mukkali Kootamadi approved).
Delete (a) close-shots of Lucy with emphasised bust, (b) the low-neckline shots; (c) shots of pockets being picked, retaining only a bare suggestion. (Replacement approved).
Reduce to a bare suggestion the brain-washing scene of Damodaran.
Delete the entire drunken revelry.
Delete the men trying to open the safe with an electric device.
Reduce Thanikachalam's statement in the court to the minimum, removing all suggestions of glorifying his crime.
